S.FORM: alang Alapawan ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Hikasiki go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 517 buwan, 1,430 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 64% kyan ku 915 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 36% kyan ku 515 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 62%, Puyuma 0.5%, binah lihuyan s'uli 0.5%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkraya' na Alapawan hya' ga Asiroay . tay mkyahu' na Alapawan hya' ga Fafokod. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. hasisyo maki 1 hasisyo. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ alapawan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu ħika[s|ɕ]iki ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan **** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** pujuma ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli ** rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkrajaʔ na alapawan ħjaʔ ɣa a[s|ɕ]iroaj taj mkjaħuʔ na alapawan ħjaʔ ɣa *a*oko* reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj ħa[s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]jo maki * ħa[s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]jo [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
